description: For every injective \(a\) and supplied ordinary program \(p\) computing it, the specified oracle program \(P_p\) satisfies \(E_{D_a}(P_p,x)=\chi_{\operatorname{range}(a)}(x)\) for every \(x\). It finds the first nondeficient position with value above \(x\), then applies the finite range test through that position.
